sourceProvenance.afterRevisionNote: Frozen Nim product sources match the profiled after snapshot. The isolated worktree retained merenda.nimble version 0.30.4 from 59b4ba35; the later unrelated 067f2c4a commit changed the final checkout manifest to 0.31.0. Benchmark and evidence files were added afterward.

ownerStructure.checkpoint: Both initialized views have structure applied and rendering queued; only Sigils is pumped, no new render chunks or code highlighting. Source and worker code strings remain live. heapWithEmptyViewsAndSource precedes either new parse.

trace.method: One fresh paused process per variant, MallocStackLogging=1, leaks --fullStackHistory --outputGraph, malloc_history high-water and live inverted call trees. Apple-reported decimal labels retained; stack logging changes memory and timing. No-stack malloc and VM blocks are separate from logged totals.
trace.caveat: Cumulative allocation-request totals are traffic, not retained memory or physical bytes copied; current and live call-tree totals use different tool accounting. Do not compare logged totals directly to untraced malloc-zone medians.

previewCache.checkpoint: Three 500-row documents in one Kosmo pane with an isolated installed SQL grammar. The baseline verifies three cached preview identities; after uses a configured zero-byte soft budget and asserts exactly one retained active preview and no pending controller work. The active document and rendered rune counts match. This is not a measurement of the default 128 MiB budget.

samplingOrder: For each workload, three fresh-process pairs alternated before then after; fixtures asserted matching source/render counts and state.

embedded.checkpoint: One visible wide code block followed by nested quoted Unicode code and linked overflow tables. Samples wait for observable main/child layout and eviction work, scroll offscreen and back, and assert selection, horizontal offset and child-storage identity. The first version of this fixture failed in both builds because its first quoted child was not initially visible; it is excluded.
embedded.limitations: At this fixture size heap differences are small relative to sample variation. RSS was higher in after samples; neither cause nor a resident-memory improvement is established. The offscreen child count is observed, not a direct byte attribution.

rssInvestigation.reason: Initial three pairs showed higher after RSS despite small lower live-heap medians. Reversed-order and allocation-stack checks investigate this without claiming RSS equivalence.
rssInvestigation.buildTemplate: In each worktree: nim c -d:release -d:useMalloc --nimcache:/tmp/merenda-owner-<variant>-cache --out:/tmp/merenda-embedded-<fixture>-<variant> tests/benchmarks/markdownembedded<fixture>.nim; variant before|after, fixture trace|cycles.

highWater.method: One paused firstRender process per variant with MallocStackLogging=all and malloc_history PID -highWaterMark -callTree -invert -noContent. Apple tool-reported MB labels retained.

rssInvestigation.liveStackObservation: At firstRender, both live call trees are dominated by the same font blobs (~49.1 MiB), sequence payloads (~37.8 MiB), and string assignments (~16.7 MiB). New segmented-storage stacks are ~25 KiB live, including ~848 bytes attributed to rangeSubstring. Freed transients are not resolved by current-live call trees.
rssInvestigation.interpretation: ABBA first-render RSS ordering reversed relative to the original three pairs; current and peak logged heap+VM matched at displayed precision, while cumulative requests increased by 0.1 MB and allocations by 317 in one traced pair. Eviction/recreation adds a small restoration cost. The 10-cycle fixture plateaus within each process, but its absolute before/after live heaps already differ at firstRender and after release, so they must not be treated as a direct saving or proven cause. No universal RSS non-regression or explanation for native/allocator variation is established.
rssInvestigation.cycleFormattingNote: The committed fixture was nph-formatted after capture; only one assignment line wrap changed. Binary was built from the measured hash.

final500RowTrace.baseline: Previously captured drawing-only churn fix on 385a01c7, corresponding to 881e74bf; see markdown-layout-churn-2026-11-06.json.

final500RowTrace.limitations: One traced process per variant; Apple labels retained as reported, stack logging changes behavior, and these rounded heap+VM figures include fonts/theme/layout and exclude unstacked blocks. Cumulative allocation requests are traffic, not retained bytes. A separate after-only trace built with -d:useMalloc is diagnostic and is not used for the matched comparison.
